verdict.rationale: Masking or redaction is a fair question for a tracing platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a LangSmith feature that hides inputs or outputs, or redacts PII, before traces are stored. Self-hosting keeps trace data in your own environment, and an OpenTelemetry Collector can route traces, but neither one masks sensitive data. Both are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can mask or redact sensitive data before it is stored in traces
